Barryroe ECT – completion of formation of Tribunal

Lansdowne Resources Plc (AIM: LRES) is pleased to announce the constitution of the ICSID Tribunal that will consider the Company’s claim for compensation from Ireland for the refusal to award a Lease Undertaking for the Barryroe oil and gas field.
The composition of the Tribunal is as follows:
Presiding Arbitrator :    Mr. Cavinder Bull SC
All are very experienced in the area of investment arbitration and we are pleased that the Tribunal has now been constituted and that the case can move forward to the next stage.
As announced in September, the Board has continued progressing the appointment of a replacement Chief Executive and this process is expected to be completed in the near future.
Meanwhile, on the ground in Brazil, the next phase of field work on the Macaubas graphite project has been scoped out and the new CEO will manage the project going forward.
Further information on the Company and the Macaubas project can be found on the Company's website at https://www.lansdowneresources.com/

Lansdowne Resources’ Interim Chairman, Luis Azevedo, commented: "We are pleased to have now completed the important step of appointing a Tribunal to hear the Barryroe ECT case. The timetable for the forward programme will now be agreed by the parties and the Tribunal.
We are also excited to be returning to the field for the next phase of evaluation work on the Macaubas graphite project.”
Lansdowne Resources (LRES.LN) was founded as an oil and gas exploration and appraisal company focused on the North Celtic Sea and quoted on the AIM market.
In May 2023 the application for a Lease Undertaking for the Barryroe Field, in which Lansdowne held a 20% interest, was refused by the Irish Department of the Environment, Climate and Communications.

In June 2023 Lansdowne announced the commencement of action under the Arbitration Process of the Energy Charter Treaty. In December 2025 the Company announced that it had secured third-party litigation funding to pursue its claim. In May 2026 it was announced that the case had been registered at ICSID (International Centre for the Settlement of Investor Disputes). Work is continuing to progress the claim.

In April 2026 the Company announced the proposed acquisition of Sao Gabriel Mineracao Ltda., a company with a graphite mining concession in Brazil. All aspects of this transaction were approved by shareholders at an AGM on 26 May 2026 and the Company resumed trading on AIM on 27 May 2026.
For more information on Lansdowne, please refer to www.lansdowneresources.com.
